singh2021.note: 99.11% verified 2026-09-08 from the article's own abstract: 'About 99.11% and 96.61% of the journals indexed in Web of Science are also indexed in Scopus and Dimensions, respectively.' The 34% figure remains unverified and is cited nowhere.
singh2021.source_of_verification: publisher abstract via Semantic Scholar 2026-08-16; reverse direction derived arithmetically from the abstract's stated size ratios
rejected_claims: 'only ~34% of Scopus journals are indexed in WoS' - this appears in the project specification but is NOT in Singh et al. Deriving it from their own published ratios gives ~81% (Scopus is ~1.23x the size of WoS and contains 99.11% of it), so the figure is wrong by a wide margin and must not be cited. The asymmetry is real but far smaller than the specification assumed; cite the direction (WoS is nearly a subset of Scopus, not vice versa) rather than a reverse percentage.
